title: COP31 Closes, Abandons Adoption of Agreement Document Due to Conflicts Over Fossil Fuels
summary: The conference ended in failure to adopt the document after a series of criticisms from Europe and others regarding references to phasing out fossil fuels and the chair's proposal.

title: Shurijo Castle Main Hall Restored from Fire and Open to the Public for the First Time in 7 Years
summary: The interior of Shurijo Castle's main hall, a symbol of Okinawa, has been rebuilt and opened to the public amidst celebrations with traditional performing arts.

title: Onosato Wins Two Consecutive Championships at the Kyushu Grand Sumo Tournament
summary: Yokozuna Onosato conquered the Kyushu tournament, holding the Emperor's Cup for the second consecutive tournament and expressing his joy at the post-tournament press conference.

title: Mets Agree with Cy Young Award Winning Left-Hander Skubal on Highest Total Pitcher Contract
summary: MLB pitcher Skubal agreed to join the Mets on a massive contract, breaking Yoshinobu Yamamoto's record.
